source_selection.policy: Eligible source-V model with highest frozen existing AsF low-urban accuracy; if none qualifies, source-best once for explicitly negative confirmation; exact tie: fixed candidate order. Never target scores; no expansion after source failure.

policy.primary: minimum mean raw IQ NMSE across six source practical views
policy.constraints: clean->clean NMSE<=.02; no TX labels/F scores/features/stochastic classification
policy.fallback: If no clean-qualified model, minimum clean NMSE, then minimum practical NMSE; negative confirmation only

scientific_verdict: Some fixed target scenes improve, but preregistered low-urban identity and clean preservation criteria not met; not a verified faithful fingerprint restorer.
